hint.forbidden: Access denied by the origin (401/403): headers are required (Referer, Origin, User-Agent, token) or the origin blocks the exit country. Check the stream headers and the egress/VPN profile.
hint.notFound: URL not found or expired (404/410): the stream has not started yet or the signed URL expired.
hint.rateLimited: The origin is rate limiting (429): lower the request rate or increase the refresh interval.
hint.serverError: Origin server error (5xx): retry later or use another source.
hint.httpError: Unexpected HTTP response from the origin.
hint.unknownFormat: Unknown format: not HLS, DASH, MP4 or MPEG-TS. If it is a web page set the type to "embed" or the strategy to "extract".
hint.noStream: No playable URL found. If the stream is inside a complex JavaScript player, enable the headless resolver (sidecar).
hint.timeout: Timeout: the origin (or the proxy/VPN) did not answer in time.
hint.network: Network error towards the origin (DNS, connection, TLS).
hint.egress: The egress profile (proxy/VPN) is unavailable: kill switch engaged, nothing was sent in clear.
hint.ssrf: Destination blocked: private or local address. Enable "allow private network" in the definition only if the source really is on your LAN.
hint.headless: The headless resolver (sidecar) does not answer: check the configured URL and that the container is running.
hint.itemGone: The event or channel no longer exists.
